description: This Java class 'JwtService' provides functionality for generating, parsing, and validating JWT tokens using the HS256 algorithm. It manages secret keys, token expiration, and exposes methods for token creation and validation within a Spring application context.

classes.name: JwtService
classes.description: A service class for handling JWT token creation, parsing, and validation using HS256 algorithm within a Spring Boot application.

methods.name: JwtService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the signing key and token expiration based on application properties.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with a subject and custom claims, setting issued and expiration times.

methods.name: parseToken
methods.description: Parses and validates a JWT token, returning claims if valid.

methods.name: validateAndGetSubject
methods.description: Validates a token and extracts the subject (e.g., email) from it.
